name: Developer -> Reviewer GitHub issue delivery
description: Canonical two-role Konoha delivery workflow for ordinary GitHub issues. GitHub labels start a Developer (Kakashi) work item, Reviewer (Shikadai) owns review, test decisions, acceptance, and closure, and optional specialists are explicit escalations outside the default path.

documents.name: Developer implementation output contract
documents.content: Implement exactly one delegated issue. Return commit_hash, changed_files, checks_run, issue_comment_url, summary, and handoff_state='state:ready-for-review'. Do not close the issue.

documents.name: Reviewer decision output contract
documents.content: Review architecture, code, and required checks for the implementation. Return review_route='approved'|'request_changes'|'blocked', decision, commit, findings, verification, closure_allowed:boolean, and reviewer_summary. The Reviewer may run tests directly. Request Shino/Hinata only for QA-heavy or release/regression scopes, request Ibiki only for security-sensitive scopes, and request Guy only through the Developer for mechanical batches. Malformed, missing, or closure_allowed=false decisions must use review_route='blocked' and fail closed.

documents.name: Reviewed close side effect contract
documents.content: Close the GitHub issue only when review_route='approved' and closure_allowed=true. Provide action_args keyed by binding_id: f_close_issue.issue.comment, f_close_issue.issue.update_labels, and f_close_issue.issue.close; preserve the Action Spine audit receipt.

documents.name: Review change request contract
documents.content: Create or update the Developer work item with reviewer findings. Keep the same workflow case and issue number; do not create a second active case for the same issue.

documents.name: Blocked review escalation contract
documents.content: Notify Naruto/operator with the blocked reason, issue URL, current commit, and required decision. Provide action_args['f_escalate_blocked_review.message.send']; wait for explicit recovery or operator instruction.

documents.name: Two-role delivery policy
documents.content: Default GitHub delivery uses at most two durable human roles: Developer=Kakashi and Reviewer=Shikadai. Naruto handles intake/exceptions, not ordinary dispatch. Shino, Hinata, Guy, and Ibiki are on-demand specialists and must not appear in the default issue path unless the issue carries an explicit specialist scope or the Reviewer/Developer requests a bounded escalation.

documents.name: Next lane selection contract
documents.content: After approved closure, scan the backlog by policy, select the next P0 lane, apply state:ready-for-dev and agent:kakashi where appropriate, and notify Naruto and Kakashi. Provide action_args keyed by binding_id: f_select_next_lane.issue.list, f_select_next_lane.issue.update_labels, and f_select_next_lane.message.send.
